what:
Regulator-count screen, TCPMT revision phase 2: datasheet gate resistance, capacitor body
footprints, mixed tiers with a tier limit, counts extended down to 16.

assumptions.R_G: datasheet RG (typ) of the high-side part, 81 of 90 parts; the other 9 (EPC7xxx, EPC210x) take the median 0.4 Ohm (HVR_epc_device_data.json)
assumptions.Q_OSS_test_voltage: datasheet test V_DS where it differs from V_DS,max/2 and the datasheet Q_OSS equals the table (9 parts, e.g. 50 V for EPC2204A/2218A/2202/2252/2203)
assumptions.tiers: a tier may hold parts of different classes; placement with a 50-um keep-out (25 um to the cell edge) in the square cell of side sqrt(I/J)
assumptions.heights_um: EPC parts: datasheet Side View nominal mounted height incl. the terminal (HVR_epc_device_data.json); inductor tier 500 (library); flying capacitor 1000 = 0603 body 0.8 mm + 0.2 mm tolerance margin
assumptions.placement_exactness: one class per tier: exact; mixed tiers up to 3 parts exact (guillotine), 4-6 parts exact for guillotine layouts plus a budgeted search for pinwheels at 4, more than 6 parts constructive (MaxRects); unresolved cases count as not placeable (tier counts can only be high)

legacy_reproduction.env: HVR_CAP_RULE=legacy HVR_SW_RULE=legacy HVR_COSS_RULE=legacy HVR_PACK_RULE=off HVR_RG_RULE=legacy HVR_FOOTPRINT_RULE=legacy
